explanations.text:
code            = the file, with a line number in front of every line

blocks          = one block per function and class, plus one "script" block
                  for the top-level code; nested defs are their own blocks,
                  the parent keeps only its own lines        (blocks_of, carve)

calls           = for each block, the names of the blocks it calls,
                  found through the scope chain              (calls_of)

layers          = Tarjan SCC over the call graph gives each block
                  a call height                              (layers_of)

for each block, bottom up by layer:
    the sequents of finished callees ride along as context
    one claude call -> takes, gives, effects, root, body     (ask_claude)
    checked, up to 8 tries                                   (check_block)

one more claude call over all texts:
    invent shared terms, rewrite every root and body,
    checked, up to 4 tries                    (vocab_pass, check_vocab,
                                               check_grounded)

links           = the name links jedi finds between blocks   (links)

! map.json      = blocks + sequents + texts + terms + links + rules
the imports (ast, json, re, subprocess, sys, pathlib, jedi)
the if __name__ == "__main__" entry point that calls main()

calls           = the call graph: block name -> callee names,
                  self-calls already dropped                 (calls_of)

comp            = Tarjan walks the graph depth first          (strong)
                      idx   = the visit number of each block
                      low   = the smallest visit number the block reaches
                      st,on = the stack of open blocks
                  when low == idx, the block closes a component:
                      pop the stack down to it,
                      every popped block points to it as representative
                  so each cycle collapses into one component,
                  and a block outside every cycle stands alone

edges           = the calls between components only;
                  calls inside a component vanish,
                  so the component graph has no cycles

h               = the height of each component               (height)
                      calls nothing        -> 1
                      calls others         -> 1 + the tallest callee

layers          = each block gets the height of its component

main then sorts by (layer, first line) and compiles upward,
so every callee sits in done before its caller speaks
